input.reasoning_summary:
The claim states that Meta's revenue growth in 2025 was broad-based across geographic regions. After investigating potential challenges, the verdict remains SUPPORTED.

Challenge H1 (whether all regions showed consistent positive growth) is REFUTED by evidence E7 and E9 from the 2025 10-K, which explicitly confirm that all four geographic regions showed positive revenue growth for the full year 2025: US & Canada (21%), Europe (24%), Asia-Pacific (20%), and Rest of World (27%). This is stronger evidence than the Q3 data (E2) initially cited, as it covers the entire year 2025.

Challenge H2 (whether growth was concentrated in one or two regions) is REFUTED by the same evidence showing that growth rates were relatively balanced across all regions, ranging from 20% to 27%. No single region dominated the growth pattern.

Challenge H3 (whether any region experienced significant declines or challenges) found NO_RELEVANT_EVIDENCE of actual revenue declines in any region during 2025. While E18 discusses general macroeconomic and geopolitical challenges, it does not report specific regional revenue declines in 2025.

The evidence review confirms that E7 and E9 are EXACT_MATCH for the period (FY2025), represent HISTORICAL_FACT statements, and ENTAIL the claim. The full-year 2025 data provides definitive support that revenue growth was indeed broad-based across all geographic regions.
